title: Dispatch: Test DM campaign-rule context, require position, fix ordering determinism (attempt 2)
description:
Dispatch of eshyra-jhpt.3 (attempt 2) — supervisor review fixes on top of attempt 1.

Attempt 1 (935d7d9) is structurally right and is KEPT. Specifically correct, do not disturb: migration 0026 campaign_turn_position with PK (campaign_id, session_id, turn_id) and UNIQUE (campaign_id, ordinal); resolveCampaignPosition's INSERT OR IGNORE + MAX(ordinal)+1 idempotency; and above all the placement of resolveCampaignPosition BEFORE `SAVEPOINT ${TURN_SAVEPOINT}` in orchestrator.runTurn — that is exactly what makes a rolled-back-and-replayed turn keep its position, which eshyra-jhpt.8 depends on. campaign/campaignContext.ts assembleCampaignRulesContext is the right shared DM/auditor projection and eshyra-jhpt.4 should consume it verbatim. The renderContextMessage "## Campaign Rules" section, including the explicit UNRESOLVED line, is the right shape.
Supervisor also measured the per-turn full-pack ambiguity scan (1812 records, ~0.13 ms per scan) — it is NOT a problem, do not optimize it.

WORKTREE / BRANCH
.worktrees/eshyra-jhpt.3.2 on branch eshyra-jhpt.3.2, cut from 935d7d9 on eshyra-jhpt.3.1. Work only inside that worktree.

FINDING 1 (PRIMARY) — nearly all of this bead's acceptance criteria are untested.
The only test added was "assigns stable campaign-wide positions across sessions and replay" (good, keep it). assembleCampaignRulesContext — the actual deliverable, and the function eshyra-jhpt.4 will reuse for auditor parity — has NO direct test, and renderContextMessage's new section has none either. The attempt-1 dispatch listed the required coverage and it was not delivered.
FIX: add real tests for all of it.
  a. Prospective / effective-turn filtering THROUGH the context projection: a rule effective later is absent at an earlier position and present at/after its effective position.
  b. A superseded rule and a revoked rule are absent at positions after the change and present at positions before it.
  c. Deterministic ordering of the returned rules.
  d. AMENDMENT A1 association data survives into the DM-facing projection: per rule, the linked ambiguityId where one exists, and governingRecordKeys, so a consumer can pair a rule with its governing source without re-deriving the association. Assert on the projection the DM actually receives, not on the store row.
  e. All three shipped ambiguities (ambiguity:create-undead-ghast-wight-composition, ambiguity:find-familiar-permanent-dismissal-after-zero-hp, ambiguity:cube-of-force-same-face-duration-reset) are surfaced when unresolved, each carrying its question and its enumerated interpretation ids/summaries, with NO preferred or default winner anywhere in the output.
  f. An ambiguity WITH an active ruling carries the ruling beside the source material — both present, source not replaced or hidden.
  g. renderContextMessage output for the unresolved case contains the explicit do-not-assert instruction, and for the resolved case names the ruling and its selected interpretation.
  h. Immutable pack bytes are unchanged after all of the above (read the pack file before and after and compare).

FINDING 2 (severe but currently latent) — an omitted campaignPosition silently produces an EMPTY campaign-rules context.
assembleContext does `input.campaignPosition === undefined ? { position: '', rules: [], ambiguities: [] } : assembleCampaignRulesContext(...)`. A caller that omits the position gets a DM context with no campaign rules and no ambiguities, with no error. This reintroduces at the context layer exactly the trap eshyra-jhpt.2 attempt 3 removed at the store layer, where campaignPosition was made REQUIRED for this reason. It is not a live production bug today — orchestrator.runTurn always supplies it — but eshyra-jhpt.4's entire requirement is that DM and auditor receive byte-identical active sets, and this makes a DM/auditor divergence silent instead of loud.
FIX: make campaignPosition required on ContextAssemblyInput and remove the empty-context fallback. The existing test call sites that omit it (contextAssemblerParty.test.ts, contextAssembler.test.ts, usageCounters.test.ts, attunement.test.ts, inspiration.test.ts and any others the compiler finds) must be updated to pass a position — that compiler error is the point of the change, not an obstacle to route around. If you conclude some caller genuinely cannot supply one, throw a domain error rather than returning an empty context, and say why in your notes.

FINDING 3 (consistency, latent) — localeCompare in the ambiguity ordering path.
campaignContext.ts ambiguitiesFromStack ends with `.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id))`. Supervisor verified this does NOT currently mis-order anything: for the three shipped ambiguity ids localeCompare and codepoint order agree. It is still locale- and ICU-build-dependent, and it is the exact construct removed from the ordering paths in eshyra-jhpt.1 (attempt 2, finding 2) because deterministic ordering is an acceptance criterion here and in .4.
FIX: replace with codepoint comparison (`a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0`), consistent with campaignRules.ts.

FINDING 4 (idiom) — campaignPosition.ts throws a plain Error.
`throw new Error('campaign turn position was not persisted')`. The codebase convention is a domain error class per module, and campaignRules.ts already exports CampaignRuleError, which eshyra-jhpt.2 attempt 2 adopted across the store for this same reason.
FIX: throw CampaignRuleError.

SCOPE
Unchanged: DM-side context plus the position assignment. No auditor wiring (.4), no player prompting (.6), no precedent inference (.7), no replay (.8), no CLI (.5). Do not alter the position-before-savepoint ordering in orchestrator.ts.

VERIFICATION
`npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root, BEFORE committing (it rewrites files).
notes:
Dispatched 2026-09-02: codex gpt-5.6-luna medium, YOLO, worktree .worktrees/eshyra-jhpt.3.2 on branch eshyra-jhpt.3.2 (cut from 935d7d9).
Completed attempt 2 fixes in commit c3db41c. Added shared campaign-context projection coverage for prospective/effective filtering, supersession/revocation, deterministic ordering, A1 ambiguityId/governingRecordKeys association, all three shipped unresolved ambiguities, ruling-beside-source rendering, unresolved/resolved render instructions, and immutable pack-byte preservation. Made ContextAssemblyInput.campaignPosition required and updated all assembleContext test callers; replaced ambiguity localeCompare with code-point ordering; resolveCampaignPosition now throws CampaignRuleError. Verification: npm run verify:worktree passed; 276 test files passed, 3 skipped; 4843 tests passed, 20 skipped. No discovered follow-ups.
